gizmo.title: Inqaku elisezantsi
gizmo.description: Inqaku elibhalwe apho lifanele khona kwisicatshulwa. Libonakala njengenani, kwaye uluhlu lwamanqaku olunamanani luzakheka ngokwalo ezantsi kwephepha.
